  • Custody and issuance integrations are moving rankings first: Stacks that win issuer workflow and distribution partnerships tend to climb platform rank ahead of category-level RWA totals. Related: Hana Bank issues South Korea’s first digital bond using Euroclear’s blockchain (CoinDesk).
